chapter.verse: Amaute' kiangpan paikhia-in tembaw tawh ka dinkhiat uh ciangin lam tangtak zui-in Cos tuikulh ka tung uh a, a zingciangin Rhodes tuikulh, tua panin Patara khua ka tung uh hi.
Phoenicia gam a tawn ding tembaw khat mu ka hih manun a tung ka kah uh a, tua tembaw tawh ka zin uh hi.
Cyprus tuikulh a kigalmuh ciangin tembaw veilam pang ngatin ka khengsuak uh a, Syria gam galkahin Tyre khua ah ka tuak uh hi. A hang pen tua khua ah tembaw in van khia ding ahih man hi.
Nungzuite va mukhia ka hih manun tua takah ni sagih ka taam uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Kha' sawlna tawh Paul' kiangah Jerusalem paisuak lo dingin gen uh hi.

Ka ciah ding hun uh a cin ciangin dingkhia-in khualzin ka zom uh a, amaute in khuapua ka tun dong uh a zite a tate uh tawh a vekun hong kha uh hi. Tua ciangin tuinawl piauzang tungah khukdinsukin thu ka ngen uh a,
khatlekhat mangpha ka kikhak uh hi. Tua ciangin ko teng tembaw tungah ka kah uh a, amau zong ciah uh hi.
Tyre pan tuilam khualzinna zo-in Ptolemais khua ka tung uh a, sanggamte hopihin amau' kiangah ni khat ka taam uh hi.
A zingciang dingkhia-in Caesarea ka tung uh a, sagihte lakah khat ahi Lungdamna Thuhilh sya Philip' inn ah lutin ama' kiangah ka taam uh hi.
Philip in kamsang tanungak li nei hi.
Sauveipi ka taam sungun Judea gam pan Agabus minnei kamsang khat hong tungsuk hi.

Tua ciangin ko' kiangah hong pai a, Paul ii kawnggak la-in ama' khut leh khe teng a khih khit ciangin, “Kha Siangtho in hih bangin ci hi: Jerusalem khua-a Jew mite in hih kawnggak neipa hici khih ding uh a, Gentile mite' khut sungah puak ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu ka zak uh ciangin ko leh tua taka om teng in Paul, Jerusalem a pai loh nading ka thum uh hi.

Tua ciangin Paul in, “Bang hangin note kapin ka lungsim kitapkhap nading hih na hi uh hiam? A hang pen Topa Jesu' min tawh Jerusalem ah kikhih ciang bek hilo, sih ding ciang nangawn a kigingsa-in ka om hi,” ci hi.
Kizol zolo ding ahih manin ko zong pau nawnlo-in, “Topa' deihna bang hita hen,” bek ka ci uh hi.
Tu-a bang teng khit ciangin van kithawi-in Jerusalem ka paito uh hi.
Caesarea khua pan nungzui kimkhat in zong hong zui uh a, ka zintun nading uh, nungzui khangtaak khat ahi, Cyprus gammi Mnason' inn ah hong paipih uh hi.
Jerusalem khua ka tun uh ciangin sanggamte in maitaiitak hong dawn uh hi.
A zingciangin ko tawh kithuahin James' kiangah Paul hawh a, makai khempeuh zong om kim hi.
Amaute a hopih khit ciangin Paul in ama' seppina tungtawnin Gentile mite' laka Pasian' sep thute khatkhit khat gencian hi.

Paul' thugen a zak uh ciangin amaute in Pasian phat uh hi. Tua ciangin Paul' kiangah, “Sanggam aw, thu a um khin Jew mite then bangzah pha cih na thei hi. Tuate a vekun thukhun lamah thalawp mahmah uh hi.

Amaute' kiangah nangma' thu kigen khinzo a, Gentile mite' laka om Jew mi khempeuh' kiangah Moses langpan ding na hilhna thu, a naupangte uh vun-atloh dingin leh i ngeina zatziate zuih loh dingin na genna thu, thei khinzo uh hi.
Tua hi a, bangci hih ding i hi hiam? Nong tun lam amaute in za pelmawh ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin kong gen danun hih in. Ko' kiangah kiciamna a bawl mi li om hi.

Tua mite paipihin amau tawh va kisiansuahkhawm inla, amau zong sam a met nadingun a bei teng sik in. Tua hileh nang' thu amau' kianga kigente khat zong kituak lo ahihna leh nang pen thukhun zui na hihna a vekpi-un hong thei ding uh hi.
Thu a um khin Gentile mite' ading ahihleh milim thoihna an, sisan, tawl-atloh sa, nulepa tatkhialhna cihte a pelh a tan nadingun i thukhensatna lai i khak khinzo hi,” ci uh hi.

Paul zong a zingciangin tua mite paipih a, amau tawh a kisiansuahkhop khit ciangin biakinnpi sungah pai-in kisiansuah hun a cin ding ni leh amaute khat ciat' ading biakpiakna luui ding hun va zasak hi.
A kiseh ni sagih hun a cin kuan laitak Asia gam pan Jew mite in biakinnpi sungah Paul a muh uh ciangin mihonpi sosuahin Paul lencip uh a,

“Israel mite aw, hong huh un! Hih mipa pen mun citeng leh mi khempeuh' tungah Pasian' mipawl ahi-a thukhun ahi-a hih mun ahi zongin langpanga thu a hilhcianpa ahi hi. Tua bek hilo, biakinnpi sungah Greek mite paipihin hih siangtho mun ninsak hi,” ci-in awng uh hi.
A hang pen tua mite in nung deuhin khuasung ah Paul leh Ephesus khuami Trophimus a kithuah mu uh ahih manin tua mipa biakinnpi sungah Paul in a lutpih a sa uh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin khuasung bup kisosuahin mite taihuan uh a, Paul manin biakinnpi sungpan kaikhia uh hi. Tua lianleh kongpite zong kikhak pah hi.
Mite in Paul thah nading thu a zon laitakun Jerusalem bup kisosuah cih thu, Rome galkap tul-uk mangpa' kiangah kizasak hi.
Tul-uk mangpa zong thakhat thu-in galkapte leh za-uk bute samin mihonpi omna delhsuk pah hi. Mihonpi zong tul-uk mangpa leh galkapte a muh uh ciangin Paul a vuak uh khawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin tul-uk mangpa hong pai-in Paul man a, khutkol nih bulh dingin thu a piak khit ciangin a matpa kua hi-a bang hihkhial cih thu dongtel hi.
Mihonpi awng ngeingai-in khatlekhat a gen uh kibang lo hi. Tua gamlumna huhau-in tul-uk mangpa in thu kician a theihkhiat zawhloh ciangin galkap len ah Paul paipih dingin thupia hi.
Paul kahlei a tun ciangin mihonpi' khauhtatna huhau-in galkapte in amah domkhia uh hi.
A hang pen mihon lompi khat in nungzuihin, “Amah hemkhiasiang un!” ci-in awng uh ahih man hi.
Paul in galkap len sung a kilutpih ding ciangin tul-uk mangpa' kiangah, “Thu khat kong gen thei ding hiam?” ci-in a dot leh mangpa in, “Greek-kam thei na hi hiam?
Tu madeuh lai-a kumpi lehdo ding vai a pankhia, misuam ngawngtan tullite gamgawtak sung a lutpih Egypt mipa hilo na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Paul in, “Kei pen Cilicia gamke Tarsus khua pan Jew mi khat ka hi a, khua thupi khat ii gammi zong ka hi hi. Mihonpi' tungah thugen nong phal nadingin kong thum hi,” ci hi.
Tul-uk mangpa in phalna a piak ciangin Paul zong kahlei tungah ding kawmin mihonpi khutvan hi. A kidaih khipkhep ciangin Paul in Hebrew-kam tawh amaute hopih a,
